remarks: Welcome to 597 Alt Boulevard. This Spacious and Turn Key Grand Island Ranch is ready for its new owner. Situated on 6.5 wooded serene acres and within walking distance to the West River. A maintenance free-vinyl exterior and double wide driveway that leads to an attached two car garage welcomes you to this special property. The large living room features a wood burning fireplace and flows seamlessly into a fully applianced eat-in kitchen with easy access to a convenience half bath and an inviting and bright family room. The family features a sliding glass door that provides access to the backyard patio. Three generous bedrooms and an updated full bath complete the main level. Original hardwood is underneath the living room and bedroom carpeted areas. The full basement offers potential for great additional living space and storage. Substantial capital improvements include updated windows, central air, architectural roof (2019), newer sump pump and hot water tank and sliding glass door (2019). Recent basement waterproofing was completed with a transferable warranty for even more peace of mind. Enjoy the outdoors on the stamped concrete patio overlooking the park like setting with mature landscaping, a variety of beautiful flowering plants and a thriving apple tree that produces an abundance of fruit each season. A great opportunity on the Island to make your new home!
